ground_slots_per_wave: one engine and one crew at each of two existing bases
aircraft_operation: Existing daylight, wind, clearance, fuel and recovery rules still apply; no third aircraft wave.
staffing: Finite predeclared resource slots; no implied replacement.
duty: Eight-hour elapsed exercise shift including flight and driving; not a legal or certified duty rule. The shift profile requires dispatch return reserve and pre-deadline recovery.
retained_values: Existing setup, refill, work, rest, flight, fire spread and burn coefficients remain unchanged.
staging: Inherited staging must be reachable and safe under the exercise router, have a route back to base, and be within three cells of eligible burning cells; not tactical safety certification.
